Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 4  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a temporal misinterpretation error, assuming that the "election held after the 2016 Michigan Democratic primary" referred to the subsequent quadrennial presidential election in 2020, rather than the next presidential election event in the 2016 cycle (held in November). This mistake stems from a misunderstanding of the chronological relationship between primaries and general elections within the same electoral cycle. By asserting that the 58th presidential election (2016) was followed by the 2020 election after the Michigan primary, the Planner incorrectly completed the task, not recognizing that the query required identifying the general election of 2016.
